items.name: German Newcomer Day 2025
items.information:
**English**

**This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025.** The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**Registrations will be accepted based on the following:**
* 50% of spots (60 spots) are initially reserved for new competitors.
* 50% of spots (60 spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
* If more than 60 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If the 60 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Deutsch**

**Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2025.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2025. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2024 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt.

**Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:**
* 50% der Plätze (60 Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert.
* 50% der Plätze (60 Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar.
* Wenn sich mehr als 60 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 60 Plätze von den zurückgekehrten Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen.
* Wenn die 60 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

#### **This is a very beginner-friendly competition! All are welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for!**
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjUwMzMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--2d81b584eaed41b3bca38d74ac30447709a1944e/NCM%202025%20A1.png)
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. 

##### The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. 

New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.
There will be special prizes to honour first-timer cubers!

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.


* Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You WILL NOT be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late for the same.

We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a comfortable ambience for all the fellow cubers. 
  
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. Please bring your ID card as well. 
 


Happy cubing!

items.information:
**NOTE: THIS EVENT IS A SERIES COMPETITION.** 

**Each participant can only compete in one of the two competitions.**

Gigiri Cubing Open AM 2025, and Gigiri Cubing Open PM 2025 are recognized as WCA series competitions.
WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in only one of them.
If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be considered valid.

The payment of 800ksh will be collected on the day of the competition at the registration desk.

This page is for Gigiri Cubing Open PM 2025.
　[Gigiri Cubing Open AM 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GigiriCubingOpenAM2025) (AM - Morning Session) - (From 8:30am to 12:30pm)
　[Gigiri Cubing Open PM 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GigiriCubingOpenPM2025) (PM - Afternoon Session) - (From 1:30pm to 5:30pm)

The registration timings for each event are as follows:
　AM : Begins at 8:30am. Closes at 9:00am
　PM : Begins at 1:30pm. Closes at 2:00pm

The New Competitor's tutorial will be held at 8:45 for AM, and 13:45 for PM. If this is your first competition, do be on time for the competitor's tutorial.

Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality.

Photos and videos are taken in the venue.

Please be familiar with the WCA Regulations, found here:
https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/

# **Mix & Match at McDo Lacson 2025**  
### *The First-Ever WCA-Sanctioned Competition Held at McDonald's in the Philippines*  

Mira Labs, in collaboration with McDonald's Lacson, is thrilled to announce this unique speedcubing event!  

---

## **Event Highlights**  
- **Main Events:**  
  - 3x3x3 and 2x2x2 Cubes, featuring **three exciting rounds each** to determine the ultimate champions.  
- **Inclusive Perk:**  
  - Each competitor will receive a **McDonald's Meal**, complete with food and drinks, which is free already if you registered—a first-of-its-kind in Philippine Cubing history!  

## **Event Details**  
This competition is open to cubers of all ages and skill levels. Join us for a day of cubing excellence, camaraderie, and great food in a vibrant and family-friendly setting.  

## **Disclaimer**  
By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, McDonald's Lacson, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this event.  

## **Be Prepared**  
All participants are encouraged to familiarize themselves with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before the event.

items.information:
### WCA Newcomer Month

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjAzODksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9f4703bb8694974000e48f846fd2d76ffa28f318/newcomer.jpg)

[FR]
C'est une compétition très accessible pour les débutants ! Tout le monde est le bienvenu mais si vous n'avez jamais participé à une compétition auparavant, c'est celle à laquelle vous devez vous inscrire !

Cette compétition fait partie du mois officiel des débutants WCA 2025. Le processus d'inscription réservera 50 % des places pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Les nouveaux compétiteurs sont considérés comme n'ayant pas d'ID WCA ou ayant un ID WCA datant de 2025. Les anciens compétiteurs sont considérés comme ayant un ID WCA datant d'avant 2024.

Les inscriptions seront acceptées selon les critères suivants :

50 % des places sont réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs, et l'autre moitié est disponible pour les autres compétiteurs, selon le principe du premier arrivé, premier servi.
Si les nouveaux compétiteurs s'inscrivent rapidement et remplissent plus de 50 % des places, les autres nouveaux compétiteurs seront acceptés en même temps que les anciens.
Si les places réservées aux nouveaux compétiteurs ne sont pas toutes prises avant la clôture des inscriptions (deux semaines avant la compétition), les places restantes seront ouvertes pour tous.

Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Romandie Doigts Rapides 2025. Vous ne pouvez vous inscrire et participer qu'à l'une de ces compétitions.

[EN]
This is a very beginner-friendly competition! Everyone is welcome but if you have never competed before this is the one to sign up for!

This competition is part of the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID from 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:

50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

This competition is a series competition with Romandie Doigtes Rapides 2025. You may only register for and compete in one of these competitions.
